title: Morning Brief — Friday, 20 November 2026
description: Australia chairs COP31 negotiations in Antalya, Queensland's regional Community Cabinet program continues with new funding for Goondiwindi, and the Gold Coast Suns wrap up a club-record AFLW season. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
